name: zork1
about: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire — a data-driven reimplementation for a-engine. Room and object text adapted from the original Zork I source (MIT licensed, github.com/devshane/zork1). Not affiliated with Activision.
defeatText: You have died. Your adventure ends here... but the Great Underground Empire endures.

overrides.winText: An almost inaudible voice whispers in your ear, 'Look to your treasures for the final secret.'
overrides.darkText: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
overrides.darkHazardText: You have walked into the slavering fangs of a lurking grue!
